zoe: ok this is peak monday energy — Miso insisted on being a sushi roll today, pls enjoy the evidence: http://imgur.com/miso-sushi.jpg :sushi: :rofl:

alex: I love how unimpressed Miso looks, classic. also 10/10 roll technique.
jamal: Miso is a national treasure. can we make this the company mascot? :raised_hands:
megan: sell merch. i would buy a Miso plushie shaped like a salmon nigiri.
zoe: blanket was from a tiny Etsy shop — link in DM if you want it, it’s basically a tortilla for cats
maria: @zoe drop the shop link here pls, urgent purchase mission
zoe: https://etsy.example/shop/cozy-pet-wraps — fair warning they sell out fast
alex: quick poll: would you adopt a Miso if offered? (yes/no/maybe)
jamal: yes (i already voted yes in my heart)
megan: maybe (depends on naps per week)
maria: yes — I have a sushi-themed cushion ready
giphy-bot: sends a reaction GIF : https://giphy.com/sushi-cat-gif
zoe: added a 2nd pic for scale — Miso vs avocado toast. outcome: Miso wins.
alex: saving these for when i'm cranky later. thank you. :heart:
jamal: official slack emoji proposal: :miso-roll: (i will pester design)
megan: instant morale boost, 10/10 thread. :sparkles:
